notes: Fixed three issues: (1) CreateLearningSpaceHandler was passing a lambda to LearningSpaceResponseFactory.ExecuteAsync instead of individual parameters; (2) LearningSpace entity needed a private parameterless constructor and private setters on properties for EF Core materialization; (3) Removed ValueGeneratedOnAdd() from EF configuration since the entity manages its own IDs via Interlocked.Increment, avoiding IDENTITY column conflicts.
